plan_point: 77.44.7.D / D-07 malformed Page Model child-list validation and rendering

repository.runtime_commit_message: fix(editor): fail closed on corrupt child lists

defect.reproduction: A JSON-persisted Page Model may contain children={toString:null} or children=[{toString:null},"missing-node"]. The previous hierarchy validator and Canvas/layer traversal could iterate a non-iterable object and throw before presenting the controlled validation failure.
fix: Hierarchy validation now accepts child collections only when they are arrays, validates every child ID before lookup, and emits safe diagnostics without coercing malformed objects.
Reachability traversal ignores invalid IDs and malformed child collections while the canonical validator reports the defect; invalid data is rejected before editing or saving.
Canvas rendering, layer traversal, selection ranges, layout Inspector and hierarchy move/drop logic use the schema's safe getChildren accessor.
Bumped the index/app/schema and commands/state validation cache URLs so the production browser cannot retain the previous validator module.
Added core and real Chromium regressions proving a controlled boot error, no page writes, and an unchanged persisted Page Model.
defect.save_publish: Separate; loading corrupt data fails closed and never saves or publishes it.

targeted_chromium.coverage: Malformed public text/link regression plus corrupt persisted Page Model child lists in the real Editor boot path; no browser exceptions, no writes, exact fixture bytes preserved.
